modalities.meaning: Authoritative block/entity/container/state that exists in the world or server state.
modalities.rule: Observation does not imply another domain can consume the state.

modalities.meaning: Native game/update/event activity that may be visible to engine listeners.
modalities.rule: A listener/consumer relationship requires separate evidence.

modalities.meaning: Authoritative state queryable through commands/datapacks or equivalent control surfaces.
modalities.rule: This is an observation modality; it does not make the observed domain programmable.

modalities.meaning: Rendered/model/audio/UI state available to a human or client-embodied agent.
modalities.rule: Client visibility is not server/world causality.

modalities.meaning: Microscope, logs, protocol/bot diagnostics, or other external evidence surfaces.
modalities.rule: Instrumentation is not part of the in-world mechanism unless deliberately embodied.
